verdict.rationale: An admin audit log is a fair security question for a workspace-based project-management SaaS like Shortcut, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of an audit log or workspace activity history. Adjacent features such as Docs Suggestion Mode and separate sandbox workspaces are not an audit log and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
